## Objective
Improve semantic clarity and technical discoverability without exposing private information.

## Scope
- Consistent ClearGlass Inc. / ClearGlass-Inc. entity naming
- Factual repository description and topics
- Architecture decision records
- Machine-readable metadata where appropriate
- Clear explanations of architecture, boundaries, tradeoffs, and operational constraints

## Acceptance criteria
- No confidential business information is exposed
- No inflated positioning or unverifiable claims
- Documentation is useful to engineers and AI retrieval systems
- Every claim is traceable to repository evidence
